name: ct_round2
description: Round-2 grey-box two-tank Torricelli ODE selected by the pre-registered rule of PREREGISTRATION-CT-ROUND2.md: structure S02 (+w3 level-dependent lower outlet), fit G0 (baseline: MSE, single shooting, 4 starts). Base of ct_phys8 (bottle-shaped lower tank, signed pump offset, overflow clamp with routed surplus, sensor offset) plus: level-dependent lower-outlet coefficient. 9 free physical parameters; the 2 initial states are fitted per record from the first 50 samples only.

fit.label: baseline: MSE, single shooting, 4 starts
fit.optimiser: scipy L-BFGS-B on JAX float64 gradients, objective as stated, on the full estimation record; best start by objective

initial_state: per-record: x0 fitted on the first 50 samples (the official state-initialisation window) with all other parameters frozen; a pump-lag state starts at the previous input (steady state), a delayed-overflow buffer starts empty (no extra fitted numbers)

selection.method: see PREREGISTRATION-CT-ROUND2.md section 4; 4 contiguous masked blocks of 256 on the ESTIMATION record, level-extrapolation check (lowest 12 % masked), smallest structure within one standard error of the best pooled CV RMSE, ties by the extrapolation check

protocol: official nonlinear_benchmarks metric RMSE(test, y_model, n_init=50), free-run simulation, test record scored once per seed via ct.protocol.test_eval (ct2/final2.py)

claim_rule.headline: mean over seeds 0-9 of the official test RMSE (never the best seed); uncertainty = paired/unpaired moving-block bootstrap (block 25) of the test residuals, NOT the seed spread (seeds are expected to collapse onto one optimum; the reference code's 0.04 seed spread comes from network initialisation and is not comparable)
claim_rule.beats_0221_entry: only if, for every one of our seeds, the 95% upper bound of the paired moving-block-bootstrap RMSE difference (ours minus the reference code's seed-42 trajectory, test[50:], block 25) is below 0 (ct/compare_ref.py)
claim_rule.beats_reference_code_in_general: reported as the fraction of the other 10 reference seeds beaten under the same paired rule
claim_rule.wording: best published result on Cascaded Tanks, official split, n_init=50 free-run simulation RMSE, self-evaluated, as of 2026-10-09 -- used ONLY if the first rule holds; otherwise 'matches/does not beat' with the numbers
claim_rule.post_hoc: any further scoring of the test record after this run (e.g. variants, ensembles, reverse split) is logged, labelled post-hoc, and excluded from the claim

claim_rule_note: copied verbatim from results/FREEZE_ct_phys8.json; only the 'as of' date in the wording is the date of this run. A result at or above 0.221 V is reported as-is.
test_record_information_used_in_design: Round 2 is NOT an independent test of the test record. The candidate families (pump lag, level-dependent lower outlet, delayed overflow return, flow-dependent routing, upper outlet height, input FIR) were chosen after the round-1 error analysis of the TEST residuals (REPORT-CT.md section 4: 86 % of the squared test error on the fast rise to the second large peak and its under-shoot; test minimum 2.16 V below the estimation minimum 2.91 V; round-1 test RMSE 0.2719 V). The selection itself used the estimation record only. No round-2 code reads test values before this freeze, and the saved round-1 test predictions were not opened. nonlinearbenchmark.org's reporting rules forbid using test data to tune structure; a board resubmission of a round-2 result would need the lead to weigh that rule.
test_record_looked_at_before_freeze: Everything in results/FREEZE_ct_phys8.json 'test_record_looked_at_before_freeze' still applies, plus the round-1 scoring of ct_phys8 (TEST-LOG.md rows 15-24) and its error analysis. In round 2 no model of ours was scored on the test record before this freeze.

gate.source: dry run in the selection kernel (full estimation record, seed 0, final hyper-parameters)
